extra:
## This work (Р-219)

- **trees, crimson:** source — the Russian Keeper Rulebook `keeper-rulebook-ru` (official; noisy text layer; the scan drops pages, so `books.json` has a `page_map` — always use `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show keeper-rulebook-ru <printed page>` and check numbers on the page image `pages.py image`). Chapter 15 «Сценарии»: «Среди древних деревьев» printed 344–361, «Багровые письмена» 362–381. Separate scans of these chapters (`1_Библиотека\Сценарии\Среди древних деревьев\[RU 7e] среди древних деревьев.pdf`, `…\Багровые письмена (Crimson Letters)\[RU 7e] багровые письмена.pdf`) are copies — use them only for pages or images missing in the book scan. Official handouts of both: `…\Багровые письмена (Crimson Letters)\Раздатка\[RU 7e] Раздатка _Среди древних деревьев_ и _Багровые письмена_.pdf` (take only yours). Records are book-scoped `keeper-rulebook-ru/<kind>/<unit>-<slug>` in `kb/books/keeper-rulebook-ru/<kinds>/` (that folder may already hold other records — create only `<unit>-*` files; never edit others). Some creatures or tomes of these scenarios may already exist in the base from the rules import (Grep `kb/` by name first) — link, never duplicate; changes to them go through proposals.
- **terror:** source — `innsmouth-terror-en` (Community Content by John Hedge, EN 7e, text layer; find the printed/physical page relation yourself and report it — the pagemap found one number only). Translate into Russian yourself (`translated` flag), names: first the owner's translation `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\2_Обработка\1923 Ужас в Иннсмуте\The_Innsmouth_Terror_RU.html` (the owner's own, rank above ours; numbers always from the English original), official forms of known names from the glossary (`python -B tools/terms.py <word>`) and existing records (Innsmouth places from «Побег из Иннсмута» are official Russian — reuse them). Five pre-generated investigators (`…\Ужас в Иннсмуте (The Innsmouth Terror)\[EN 7e] 3500905-*.pdf`) — character records of this book. Records `innsmouth-terror-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/innsmouth-terror-en/<kinds>/`.
- Common: scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, tomes, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. Cities — shared records (Р-190): Arkham `coc:location:arkham`, Innsmouth `coc:location:innsmouth`, Miskatonic University `coc:location:miskatonic-university`, Orne Library `coc:location:orne-library` exist — never rewrite them, add through proposals; Bennington `coc:location:bennington` is new and belongs to unit trees. Places outside a city — under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209; Arkham's is `keepers-companion-en/location/arkham-environs`). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/<unit>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). New spells — draft them in your report (`kb/spells` is shared).
- `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35).
- Coverage: `checks/20261111-played/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
